narrative.summaryIntro:
Badrinath Temple is one of the four cardinal shrines (Char Dham) of Hindu pilgrimage and is dedicated to Lord Vishnu in his form as Badrinath (Badrinarayan). Located in the Chamoli district of Uttarakhand at an elevation of 3,300 meters, the temple is situated in a scenic valley surrounded by the Himalayas.

The temple features a distinctive red and gold pagoda-style architecture. It has been a major pilgrimage center for centuries, attracting devotees from across India and the world who seek blessings and spiritual enlightenment at this sacred shrine of Vishnu.
